Companion Animal Travel Desk Guide for First-Time Travelers

If you are flying with a companion animal, the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways helps you get ready with clear steps and calm support. The goal is to make the process easier before you reach the gate, so you know what to expect and what your animal needs.

Start by checking in with the desk early and bringing any paperwork you were told to carry. The staff will look over your details, confirm your travel plan, and explain how your carrier will be handled. If your pet is nervous, let the team know right away so they can guide you through the next steps with extra care.

For birds, the desk follows specific crate rules. <<FACT F071>> The team will also help you check that the carrier is secure, comfortable, and ready for travel without loose parts or gaps that could cause trouble. If you are unsure about sizing or setup, ask before you leave home so there is time to fix it.

Age rules matter too, especially for younger birds. <<FACT F077>> If you are traveling with a very young animal, bring up the details early so the desk can confirm the plan and avoid delays at check-in.

A safety coordinator reviews common hazards and helps prevent them before departure. The ground team moves carriers carefully between services, and supervisors pay close attention when a passenger is worried or needs extra reassurance. That means you can count on steady support while your pet is being prepared for the trip.

To keep things simple, keep your animal calm, keep the carrier closed unless staff ask you to open it, and follow the directions you are given at the desk. If anything changes with your booking or your pet's condition, tell the team as soon as you can.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk or speak with Aurelia Skyways customer support.
